title: BAASS Project Forum and TTSA as holdover

tellings.quote: discussion of a project forum >> within those which was to basically in California take you know celebrities, media personalities, popular people to start talking about the UFO subject

plain: Around 2011 there was a plan called Project Forum to get celebrities, media personalities and other popular people in California talking about UFOs, according to a researcher who goes by the online name UAPGerb. He says he found it in documents from BAASS, the company that ran a Pentagon-funded study of the unexplained, and from a related office he calls OSAP. He sees TTSA, a later private UFO venture linked to Tom Dong and to a former Pentagon official named Luis Elizondo, as a holdover of that plan, which would mean the public UFO push of recent years was planned in advance.
